I am a 42-year-old farmer in Dedza with no schooling, and my beans plot is only 0.08 hectares, so I must be careful with every kwacha. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I will save any fertilizer I might get for my maize and instead put manure on this plot to help it grow. I have kept my own bean seed for many years and my family can manage the weeding and harvesting by hand, so I do not need to buy improved seed, chemicals, or hired labor, and I will depend on the rains as I always have.
